scope: Implemented additive daily run counts only; not the proposed three-tier architecture.

requirements.activity-runtime: Checked-in cao-activity workflow collects GitHub simulator evidence with real gh-aw, ingests and publishes daily counts, restores cache, replays, corrects reruns and rebuilds recycle-only snapshots
requirements.classification: UTC execution-start days and exclusive health counters summing to total
requirements.reconciliation: Replay, winning attempts, explicit nulls, corrections and atomic replacement
requirements.retention: Independent detail expiry, three UTC weeks, rollover, future exclusion and replay fences
requirements.backfill: Bounded resumable upgrade, unchanged retained detail and partial historical coverage
requirements.availability: Undated evidence and absent or incomplete state cannot manufacture healthy zeros
requirements.workflow-health: Shipped workflow runtime health query sums observations without detail fallback
requirements.daily-chart: Shipped runtime health chart preserves UTC buckets, zero classes and supported scope
requirements.repository-chart: Shipped repository chart preserves scoped counts, inventory identities and coverage
requirements.native-browser: Chromium native IndexedDB and a real data worker preserve all migrated consumers

coverage.retention: Activity doctor publishes UTC rollover eviction independently of detail TTL and fences changed-shard replay
coverage.backfill: Activity SQLite v44 upgrade backfills multiple cursor pages without rewriting retained detail

coverage.activity-runtime: cao-activity publishes replay-safe daily counts and statistical queries through the Actions runtime

coverage.classification: matches every mutually exclusive runtime health class and uses UTC start dates only
coverage.reconciliation: rolls back canonical run, contribution and bucket changes together on a count write failure
coverage.retention: runs independent TTL and weekly eviction through deferred ingestion and unchanged replay in %s
coverage.backfill: resumes an interrupted v%s backfill with bounded cursors and byte-identical retained detail
coverage.availability: fails closed for absent state in direct and native production queries
coverage.workflow-health: composes the shipped workflow health query through the worker after corrections and detail deletion
coverage.daily-chart: serves the shipped daily chart with scoped UTC buckets, corrections, and no detail dependency
coverage.repository-chart: lists repository run counts and drill links through the production worker boundary

suites.pattern: (production data worker preserves daily health and repository chart coverage after detail eviction|native IndexedDB ingestion expires detail and weekly counts on unchanged-shard finalization)$

coverage.retention: native IndexedDB ingestion expires detail and weekly counts on unchanged-shard finalization
coverage.native-browser: production data worker preserves daily health and repository chart coverage after detail eviction
